Name: Sv Immersive Farm
Author: YsaNusa
Description:
This is a map mod where I made it half of the original, because the original map has a very large size, I have difficulty managing all parts of the map, special thanks for the owner of Immersive Farm 3 [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/sexynes/about-me?gameId=1303]Sexynes[/url] for telling me this map has not been updated since 2019 and allowing me to make this,

Here I only made it half and I also made a world map for all seasons, where on other immersive maps it only changes in spring, and other seasons will make it default, I also make World Map for SVE too.

If you dont want a fences, just set in GMC

I added a cave mod in bottom cave to spice up the game :
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13855]Lnh's Special Farm Cave
[/url]
Please let me know if you find any bugs or anything.

New :
[list=1]
[*]I added a background that can be customized according to the season.

[*]On the map, it looks different for Bus Stop, yes I have finished the mod where I adjusted Daisy Niko's map called Reimagined III which has not been updated for a long time, this makes the town, mountain, backwoods, forest etc different, and also I made it compatible for SVE, but I haven't gotten an answer from Daisy Niko for permission to upload, because he is still offline
[*]I make the house look simple

[/list]
